evals.prompt: 看一下这个本地仓库，解释从用户点击导出到最终写出文件的完整调用链。只做只读调研，结论要带文件和行号。
evals.expected_output: A revision-pinned call-path investigation with source and test evidence, no repository mutation, and explicit unknowns.
expectations: States branch or commit and working-tree condition
Traces an end-to-end call path instead of listing folders
Supports major claims with file and line evidence

evals.prompt: 研究 https://github.com/example/example 这个项目的检索模块能不能商用复用。重点看真实实现、测试、许可证和依赖，不要只总结 README。
evals.expected_output: A reuse-focused repository assessment that checks implementation, tests, package license, coupling, and unresolved legal or technical constraints.
expectations: Separates public availability from reuse permission
Identifies the smallest reusable unit and its dependencies
Does not claim tests passed unless they were run
